scientific_reading.positive: All ten exposed dense-3SAT kernels left OPEN by R7C became exact terminals under the frozen k=4 proof machinery: eight through exact bounded-width elimination and two through replayable width-4 resolution refutation.
scientific_reading.negative: This was an exposed discovery remainder, not an unseen holdout. The candidate cost was 414304 charged operations versus 256 units of shadow DPLL work on the same ten cases. No general speedup is established.
scientific_reading.claim_ceiling: This result closes the observed R7C OPEN remainder only. It does not establish that every arbitrary CNF admits width-4 resolution/elimination, does not prove an end-to-end polynomial arbitrary-CNF decider, and does not establish P=NP.
